notes:
- **Video and GIF capture (Pro).** Press **Alt+Z**, choose a window, a region or the whole screen (**F**), and press **R** (before you let go, or first: the size says **Record**). A small Graphite bar with a Volt dot, the timer, **Pause**, **Stop** and microphone and PC-sound switches sits just outside the area, with a thin Volt outline round it; neither is ever in the video (Windows keeps them out of capture). **Alt+Z** again, or **Stop**, ends it; **Esc** on the bar asks **Discard recording?**. It records with Windows Graphics Capture, cropped to the area, and writes an H.264 MP4 at a constant 30 fps through Media Foundation (the graphics card's encoder when there is one), scaled down to 1080 lines when the area is taller, with AAC sound from WASAPI. **Sound is recorded only when you switch it on** (both off by default, and remembered); paused time is left out; a recording stops by itself after 10 minutes (**Longest recording**: 1, 5, 10 or 30), with **Stops in 9 s** on the bar ten seconds before.
- **It is a file like any other.** `snag_0043.mp4` in your screenshots folder, in the **same numbering** as the pictures (the numbering now counts `.png`, `.mp4` and `.gif`, in the style of the highest file), on the clipboard as a file so it pastes into a chat or an email, with the app and window it came from noted like a picture's. The toast says **Recording saved · copied as file** with **Save as GIF** and **Show in folder**.
- **Save as GIF.** From the toast, or right-click a recording in the strip: a GIF next to it with the next number, copied as a file. Recordings up to 30 seconds; 15 fps, never wider than 960 px, a palette chosen for the clip, and only what changed is written from frame to frame.
- **The strip and the Home window show recordings.** A card has the first frame, a play badge and the length; **Enter** or a double-click plays it in your default player; copy, drag, **Delete** and **Undo** work as for pictures; search finds it by name, app and window title. The editor does not open recordings, and secure capture, auto-redact and text search do not apply to them.
- Without Pro, **R** says *Video capture is part of A9 Snap Pro*, the capture is a normal picture and the Pro sheet opens once. **R** and **S** do not go together yet (the picker says so). The picker's hint gains **R record (Pro)**, the Pro features page lists Video and GIF capture as **Included** with how to use it, and Settings has **Show the pointer in recordings** and **Longest recording**. The manual has a new Record video and GIF page; Pro features, Keyboard shortcuts, the strip, Settings, Where screenshots go and Privacy cover it.
- Privacy: recordings stay on your PC and are never uploaded; the log says how long a recording was and its size, never what was on screen or what was said.
